ios.desc:
A single piece of paper for your peace of mind. That's exactly what Quick Notes is all about – a nifty place to jot down your thoughts as quickly as possible so you can let them go and decide what to do with them later. No lists, no excessive clutter – just open and take notes.

Practicality and simplicity is deeply rooted in Quick Notes. Its meticulously arranged main screen, along with Home Screen Widgets, Apple Watch Complications, and Notifications keep you up to date efficiently.

In addition, you can use Headings and Check marks to make your notes clearer at a glance, add a new note directly on your Apple Watch, customize the Widgets, or take control over the Dark Mode – all this and more with just a one-time purchase we call Everything.

Features:
• Single sheet for your quick notes and drafts
• iCloud synchronization
• Home Screen Widgets
• Apple Watch Complications
• Reminder

Additionally with Everything (a one-time in-app purchase):
• Headings
• Check marks
• Swipe left to delete a line
• Version history
• Appearance under control
• Adding and ticking notes on Apple Watch
• Character counter
• Widget customization

The app is ideal for things like to-do lists, grocery lists, packing lists, room numbers, tracking codes, or to remember your parking space.
